name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
accessNote: Requires Dragon Slayer II. Corsair Cove Dungeon black dragons are close to a bank using a Mythical cape teleport. Blue dragon area contains 5 adults and 3 babies, is cannonable, and can be safespotted.
